card.title: 64. PANZERGRENADIER
card.text: Becomes Veteran if it starts your turn in the frontline.
card.flavorText: The 64th Panzergrenadier Regiment was a unit of the 16th Panzer Division of the Wehrmacht during WWII. The division was formed in 1940 and participated in Operation Barbarossa in June 1941, where it fought in the Battle of Dubno and the Battle of Kiev. In 1942 they took part in the Second Battle of Kharkov and Case Blue, the German summer offensive in southern Russia. After Operation Uranus, the Soviet offensive in November 1942, the division was trapped in Stalingrad where most of its men were either killed or captured by the Red Army. The division was formed again in 1943 and sent to Italy to defend against the advancing Allied forces. In November 1943 it was sent to the Eastern Front where it participated in an attempt to break the encirclement of Axis troops caught in the Korsun-Cherkassy Pocket. In 1944 the division found itself trapped in the Kamenets-Podolsky pocket, but they managed to break out with the 1st Panzer Army and from there they  retreated to Poland. The 16th Panzer Division finally surrendered to Soviet and US forces in Czechoslovakia in May 1945.
